title: Senior Devops Engineer (Azure+ AWS)
jobDescription:
Job Purpose We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Dev Ops Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Cloud Formation/Bicep), containerization, Kubernetes, automation, and Dev Sec Ops. The role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing secure, scalable, and highly available cloud platforms while driving automation and continuous delivery. The engineer will collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to implement best practices in cloud architecture, monitoring, security, governance, and cost optimization, while contributing to reusable Dev Ops frameworks and ensuring operational excellence across multi-cloud environments. Job Description Collaborate with development teams to establish and enhance continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including source code management, build processes, and deployment automation. Publish and disseminate CICD best practices, patterns, and solutions. Design, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure components using platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, and other cloud providers. Implement and manage infrastructure as code (Ia C) using tools like Terraform or Bicep or Cloud Formation to ensure consistency, scalability, and repeatability of deployments. Monitor and optimize cloud-based systems, addressing performance, availability, and scalability issues. Implement and maintain containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes to enable efficient deployment and management of applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve operational issues, troubleshoot incidents, and improve system reliability. Establish and enforce security best practices and compliance standards for cloud infrastructure and applications. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and monitoring tasks using tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. Ensure that the service’s uptime and response time SLAs/OLAs are met or surpassed. Build or maintain CICD building blocks and shared libraries proactively for app and development teams to enable quicker build and deployment. Actively participate in bridge calls with team members and contractors/vendors to prevent or quickly address problems. Troubleshoot, identify, and fix problems in the Dev Sec Ops domain. Ensure incident tracking tools are updated in accordance with established norms and processes, gather all essential data and document any discoveries and concerns. Align with technological Systems/Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and industry-standard service management principles (such as ITIL). Create and publish engineering platforms and solutions. Job Specification Expertise in any one of Azure/AWS/GCP. Azure is a mandatory requirement. 8+ years of related job experience. Strong experience in containerization and container orchestration technologies
- Docker, Kubernetes, etc. Strong Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Terraform/Bicep/Cloud Formation, etc Knowledge of Dev Ops Automation (Terraform, Git Hub, Git Hub Actions) Good knowledge of Monitoring/Observability tools and processes inclusive Cloud Watch, ELK stack, Cloud Trail, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus. Infra monitoring using Nagios or Zabbix. Experience in working with Operations team in Agile Development model and all SDLC phases. Comprehensive technical expertise in a variety of Dev Sec Ops toolkits, including Ansible, Jenkins, Artifactory, Jira, Black Duck, Terraform, Git/Version Control Software, or comparable technologies Familiarity with information security frameworks and standards. Exposure to the Render cloud platform is desirable and considered a plus. Familiarity with API Security, Container Security, Azure Cloud Security Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills. Strong debugging/troubleshooting skills. To adhere to the ISMS policies and procedures.

title: Cloud Engineering - Sr Architect
jobDescription:
Job Purpose Experion Technologies is looking for a Senior Cloud Architect with a strong focus on infrastructure. The ideal candidate will design, implement, and manage enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure solutions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). This role requires expertise in AI-driven cloud automation, including AIOps, MLOps, and Fin Ops practices. The candidate will work directly with enterprise architects from US, Australia, and European customers to deliver innovative cloud solutions and architectural designs. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills are essential for success in this customer-facing role. - solid understanding and hands-on experience setting up and managing cloud infrastructure and services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, Security groups, VPN, Azure VMs, AKS, GKE, etc.) Proficiency in networking and network security e.g. SSL/TLS certificates, VPN IPSec tunnels, firewalls, WAF, DDo S protection Knowledgeable of web/application servers and load balancers such as Amazon ELB/ALB/NLB, Azure Load Balancer, Tomcat, Nginx, Apache Http Server etc. Extensive experience with designing and managing cloud security using IAM, RBAC, Azure AD, AWS Organizations, SCPs AI & Automation Skills (Mandatory): AIOps expertise
- implementing intelligent monitoring, automated incident response, and predictive analytics using tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Pager Duty, or similar. MLOps experience
- building and managing ML pipelines, model deployment, monitoring, and versioning (MLflow, Kubeflow, Sage Maker, Vertex AI) Ability to design self-healing infrastructure and automated incident response workflows to reduce “toil.” Fin Ops practices
- cloud cost optimization, resource rightsizing, reserved instance planning, and cost allocation strategies Awareness of latest market trends, emerging cloud technologies, and AI adoption patterns in enterprise environments Dev Ops & Platform Engineering Application development background (Java/.NET/Python) to understand application architecture and integration requirements Solid understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices, and experience in setting up CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Azure Dev Ops etc. Solid experience with build and SCM tools
- Maven, Gradle, Git, Jira, Sonar Qube Sound knowledge on containerization concepts, Docker and Kubernetes and good working knowledge on various Kubernetes environments (standalone clusters and managed services like EKS, AKS, GKE) Good knowledge of Monitoring/Observability tools and processes
- Cloud Watch, ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Open Telemetry Experience with Terraform, Cloud Formation, ARM, Pulumi, Crossplane as infrastructure-as-code Exposure to microservice architecture, API gateway, Service Mesh, Blue/Green deployments, Canary deployments Experience with serverless approaches using AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions Prior migration experience with on-prem to cloud and cloud-to-cloud migrations Understanding of Agile principles and experience participating in scrums and agile processes Scripting Skills
- Python, Bash, Power Shell, Go Duties and responsibilities Customer Engagement & Solution Architecture: Work directly with enterprise architects of US, Australia, and European customers in providing solutions and architectural designs Excellent communication, presentation, and articulation skills to convince customer stakeholders and technical teams Prepare and present potential technical solutions and advise customers, businesses, and product owners on the technical and business value of proposals, including appropriate trade-offs Involve in Pre-sales/Development activities and provide cloud solutions to customers Onsite travel may be required for short-term engagements with customers Technical Leadership & Hands-on Execution: Cloud platform Design & Architecture with focus on infrastructure resilience and scalability Must be willing to be hands-on when critical situations arise
- troubleshooting, incident response, and emergency fixes Migration of infrastructure/applications to hybrid/multi-cloud environments Designs and implements cloud solutions/infrastructure for organizations/applications, collaborating with customer stakeholders and application architects Architecting solutions using cloud infrastructure and services for application/product development Support Development team to leverage various cloud services/integration services to provide better value to customers AI-Driven Cloud Operations: Implement and manage AI-based automation for cloud engineering platforms including proactive alerting and self-healing mechanisms Design and implement AIOps solutions for intelligent monitoring, automated remediation, and predictive maintenance Establish MLOps pipelines and practices for deploying and managing ML models in production Drive Fin Ops initiatives
- cost visibility, optimization recommendations, and governance policies Security & Governance: Responsible for designing comprehensive security architecture that aligns with organization’s business objectives, risk tolerance, and regulatory requirements Developing architectural solutions considering the organization’s existing IT infrastructure to address security gaps Ensuring the security of cloud-based data and applications against unauthorized access, theft, and other threats Conducting regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and develop plans to address them Work in close coordination with the Engineering team to adhere to ISMS Policies and procedures Team Leadership & Collaboration: Strong team mentoring skills
- guide and develop junior architects and engineers Should be able to work effectively as part of a team and foster collaborative environments Provide technical guidance and educate team members and coworkers on development and operations best practices Establish best practices for cloud adoption and work with IT teams to monitor cloud privacy and address technical issues Good understanding of platform engineering
- help team design/build efficient development systems Dev Ops & Platform Engineering: Systems automation, orchestration, deployment, and implementation Write infrastructure as code using Terraform, Cloud Formation, Pulumi or similar Technical direction in design and implementation of CI/CD processes and pipelines A commitment to best practices on operational processes for Dev Ops Manage code repositories and create branching strategies to improve software development efficiency Evaluation of cloud providers, cloud applications, hardware, and software Job Specification / Skills and Competencies Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline or the equivalent combination of education, technical certifications and work experience. Preferred Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional / Azure Solutions Architect Expert / Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS) preferred Cloud security certifications (CCSP, AWS Security Specialty) are a plus

Experience in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning techniques Hands-on experience with predictive analytics, anomaly detection, recommendation systems, NLP, and computer vision Strong understanding of feature engineering, model training, tuning, validation, and deployment Experience with MLOps frameworks and model lifecycle management. Proven ability to lead technical teams and manage delivery timelines.

title: Cloud Engineering Practice Manager
jobDescription: Job Purpose We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Cloud Engineering Practice Manager to lead our pre-sales and practice development initiatives. This strategic role combines technical expertise in cloud engineering, Dev Ops, and SRE with strong business acumen to drive growth, build client relationships, and deliver innovative solutions. The ideal candidate will be a thought leader who bridges the gap between technical capabilities and business outcomes while working across multiple geographies. Prepare comprehensive proposals and respond to RFQ/RFP/RFI for cloud engineering, Dev Ops, and SRE engagements with compelling value propositions. Lead capability presentations and technical demonstrations with new customers, showcasing the organization’s expertise and differentiators. Collaborate closely with senior sales stakeholders across different geographical regions to effectively present cloud, Dev Ops, and SRE capabilities to new and existing customers. Innovation & Market Differentiation Proactively create accelerators, frameworks, and tools that differentiate the organization in the market and deliver tangible value to customers. Collaborate with the AI team to develop and integrate AI-powered solutions within cloud engineering, Dev Ops, and SRE offerings.
